question: Pawl Kut is a thanksgiving festival of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pawl Kut:-**

 
 
• **It is a thanksgiving festival celebrated by the Mizos, an ethnic group belonging to the state of Mizoram in India.**
 
• It is usually celebrated in the month of February and is a harvest festival that marks the end of the agricultural year.
 
• The festival is characterized by traditional dances, music, and feasting, where people gather to express gratitude for a bountiful harvest and seek blessings for the coming year.
 
• The festival also has religious significance as it involves the offering of prayers to the deity of harvest and fertility, called Pathian.
